75% of Americans now say the economy is "poor." 

No matter how much Trump goes on Fox News to try to gaslight consumers about his economy, the pain people are feeling is real.

pbs.org/newshour/politics/ap…

Trump promised to lower gas prices. Instead, he started a war with Iran that sent oil to over $4 a gallon—and increasing every day. 

Working families are paying the price for Trump’s war.

Did you know that Donald Trump could appoint two more Supreme Court Justices?

Video

Happy birthday to our Bailey. Eight years of golden retriever energy and unconditional love. 

You've walked the campaign trail, stolen every selfie, and reminded us every single day what really matters the most—burritos.

What we're really seeing in Iran is another forever war. A war with no obvious end.

Donald Trump has demonstrated over and over and over that he has no plan and no exit ramp.

Republicans in Congress must act.

The Paramount-Warner Bros merger reeks of corruption.

Trump said he would be “personally involved" in the transaction.

He said he wanted Netflix & Paramount “to compete for his approval.”

He reportedly shared “implicit support” for Paramount’s bid. 

I'm sounding the alarm.

13 Americans have been killed, and hundreds more are injured.

We’re spending $1 billion in taxpayer funds a day.

Gas is more than $4 per gallon.

This is the cost of Trump's war.

Graham has inspired the people of Maine because he's the fighter for working people that we need in the Senate.

He’s ready to fight for universal health care, taxing the rich and unrigging the system that benefits the wealthy and well-connected.

Let's win this @grahamformaine.

The Big Four airlines (American, Delta, Southwest, United) control 75% of the U.S. market.

Fewer choices = higher prices for you.
Community note: In 2024, Senator Warren supported the Biden Administration’s DOJ suing to prevent the merger between JetBlue and Spirit, fearing “fewer flights and higher fares”. Now Spirit shutdown, resulting in fewer flights and less competition.

A billion dollars a day and thousands of lives lost from a war with no strategy, no exit plan, and no explanation. I went on Colbert and said what bears repeating: Republicans in Congress need to stand with us and stop this war.

DOGE wasn't fixing Social Security—they were making it harder to get your hard-earned benefits.

We created the Social Security War Room to fight back.
theguardian.com/us-news/2026…

Millions in oil futures traded minutes before Trump's Iran ceasefire.

Then the White House had to remind staff not to trade on insider info.

We need a full investigation. The American people deserve answers.

The Trump administration is starting to give refunds from his illegal tariffs.

Not to the consumers who paid for more expensive goods—only for the corporations that raised their prices on those consumers.

Donald Trump must give the American people their money back.

People can't afford groceries, but Republicans in Congress want taxpayer money for Trump's gold-encrusted ballroom.


FactPost (@factpostnews)

Republicans have introduced legislation to use taxpayer funds to pay for Trump's $400 million ballroom, despite Trump having already secured private funds to cover the ballroom.







— https://nitter.net/factpostnews/status/2049140627628056643#m

Pete Hegseth gutted programs created to reduce civilian harm right after he took office.

Now, thousands of innocent people in Iran are dead from what could have been preventable tragedies.

Hegseth is dangerous. Congress must rein him in and end this war now.
